bugs_found: apply_fee converts fee_min with Decimal(float(fee_min)), introducing binary floating-point precision errors; use Decimal(str(fee_min)) consistently
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float/int inputs can cause mixed Decimal arithmetic errors or inconsistent comparisons
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), which can produce incorrect financial results for non-integer inputs
